_README: MARKER-ONLY. Never fetched by the student's browser until a teacher/marker PDF is generated. Never render any of this on the student-facing page. See CLAUDE.md section 5's assessment-security amendment.

markingScheme.criterion: Quotes the Spanish words of one real task from their own Record (e.g. 'Nosotros somos', 'la chica alta') that they got wrong or needed two tries for.
markingScheme.accept: Any task in the student's own Record with Tries 2 or Right = No; if the Record is perfect, any task from it. Accents not required.
markingScheme.insufficient: Describing a rule in general with no task or Spanish words taken from their Record.

markingScheme.criterion: States the correct rule behind that task (regular -er endings -o/-es/-e/-emos/-en and -ir with nosotros -imos; boot verbs jugar u→ue and querer e→ie with nosotros unchanged; jugar al + sport; apetece (Spain) vs late (Mexico); móvil/celular; baloncesto/básquetbol).
markingScheme.accept: Any correct rule that fits the quoted task, in English or Spanish, in the student's own words.
markingScheme.insufficient: 'I got it wrong' or 'it changes' with no stated reason or pattern.

markingScheme.criterion: Writes one new, correct Spanish example that follows the stated rule.
markingScheme.accept: Any grammatically correct Unit 1 example (minor accent slips allowed if the form is clear), different from the quoted task.
markingScheme.insufficient: Repeating the quoted task, or a new example with a wrong verb form or ending.

markingScheme.criterion: Home and sport: a correct 'vivir' form (vivo/vives/vive/vivimos/viven) AND a correct 'jugar al + sport' with the right form (juego/juegas/juega/jugamos/juegan).
markingScheme.accept: e.g. 'Vivo en Madrid' and 'Juego al fútbol'. Accents optional.
markingScheme.insufficient: 'Vivo' with a wrong ending ('vivemos'), 'jugo', or 'juego en fútbol'.

markingScheme.criterion: Wants and -er verb: a correct 'querer + infinitive' (quiero/quieres/quiere/queremos/quieren) AND one correct regular -er verb form (como, corremos, lee...).
markingScheme.insufficient: 'Quero', 'quieremos', or a wrong -er ending ('comimos' for nosotros present).

markingScheme.criterion: Invitation and English line: a correct invitation (¿Te apetece ...? or ¿Te late ...?) AND an English explanation that jugar and querer change their stem vowel in some forms (u→ue, e→ie) but not for nosotros/vosotros.
markingScheme.accept: Any invitation using apetece or late and an accurate stem-change explanation.
markingScheme.insufficient: No invitation, or an explanation saying the endings (not the stem) change, or that nosotros changes.

criteria.source: = the Explain question's 3-point marking scheme above, one-to-one. Do not award these marks a second time here.

levels.descriptor: None of the three analytic points achieved: no real task quoted from the Record, no correct rule, and no correct new example.
Achieves only ONE of the three: quotes a real task from their Record OR states a correct rule OR gives a correct new example.
Achieves TWO of the three analytic points.
Quotes a real task from their own Record, states the correct rule, and gives a correct new Spanish example — all three analytic points present.

criteria.source: = the Apply question's 3-point marking scheme above, one-to-one. Do not award these marks a second time here.

levels.descriptor: None of the three analytic points achieved: no correct vivir + jugar al sentence, no correct querer + -er verb, and no correct invitation with a stem-change explanation.
Achieves only ONE of the three analytic points.
Achieves TWO of the three analytic points.
Correct vivir and jugar al sentence, correct querer and -er verb, and a correct invitation plus an accurate stem-change explanation — all three analytic points present.

criteria.source: Assessed holistically across BOTH the Explain and Apply answers together — independent of, and never overlapping with, the content marks in use_of_evidence and spanish_use above.

levels.descriptor: Too unclear or incomplete for the meaning to be followed reliably.
Main meaning understandable, but organisation, vocabulary or precision cause some difficulty.
Clear and logical, uses Unit 1 vocabulary, and is easy to follow. Minor spelling or accent slips that do not harm meaning are not penalised.

markingInstructions: Mark ONLY the two constructed responses (Explain, Apply). Award marks point-by-point using each question's markingScheme: each point is worth the marks stated and is independent unless it names a dependsOn point (award it only if that earlier point was also awarded). use_of_evidence's 3 marks ARE the Explain scheme's 3 points and spanish_use's 3 marks ARE the Apply scheme's 3 points; award each set once, not twice. communication is a separate, holistic 2 marks across both answers. The Knowledge Check is ADAPTIVE (levels L1-L5): each student answers 5 one-mark items pitched at their level, so copy auto_marked_score into knowledge_accuracy (out of 5) and do not penalise a lower level; the level path is printed in the PDF. Use the student's logged Record to verify any task they quote. Students are true beginners (A1): accept valid alternative wording and do not penalise a missing accent unless it changes the meaning. Total is out of 13 (5 auto + 3 + 3 + 2). Report total, percentage, one strength, one correction, one next step, under 80 words.
